description.zh:
排序方式，取值如下：
- Desc：降序。
- Asc：升序。
description.en:
The sorting order. Valid values:

- Desc: Descending order.

- Asc: Ascending order.

description.zh: 虚拟资源组列表的页码。起始值为1，默认为1。
description.en: The page number for the list of virtual resource groups. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的虚拟资源组数量，默认为100。
description.en: The number of virtual resource groups to display on each page. The default value is 100.

description.zh: 排序字段。按时间戳类型默认倒序排序。
description.en: The field that is used to sort the results. By default, the results are sorted by timestamp in descending order.
The ID of the virtual resource group.
The name of the virtual resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eas list-virtual-resource --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --virtual-resource-id eas-vr-npovr28onap1xxxxxx --virtual-resource-name MyVirtualResource --sort CreateTime --order Desc --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eas GET /api/v2/virtualresources --region cn-hangzhou --Order Desc --VirtualResourceName MyVirtualResource --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --VirtualResourceId 'eas-vr-npovr28onap1xxxxxx' --Sort CreateTime --header "Content-Type=application/json"
